# Rubato Garden Lounge

> Rubato Garden Lounge is a garden lounge in Prishtinë, Kosovo. This site is its digital menu, available in English and Albanian, with a day menu and a night menu (served from 7:00 PM).

## Menu

- [Day menu](https://rubatogardenlounge.com/): all food categories
- [Night menu](https://rubatogardenlounge.com/night-menu): after-dark menu, served from 7:00 PM

## Contact

- Address: 18 Hyzri Talla, Prishtinë
- Phone: +383 43 508 502
